error_codes.description: The call was stopped in flight, at its next cancellation point: its Client sent `$/cancel`, or what it needed was closed under it.
error_codes.name: call_cancelled

error_codes.description: Windows refused to start the file: Smart App Control, or another App Control policy, blocks executables without a signature or reputation it trusts. Goodfetch never re-signs a file it did not build. For a browser, use the Goodfetch Chromium or an installed Chrome by channel; otherwise turn Smart App Control off, or ask the device's administrator to allow the file.
error_codes.name: executable_blocked_by_smart_app_control

error_codes.description: The engine's own resolver got no usable answer for the host name: its name servers timed out, refused the query, failed or could not be reached. Check the name servers of the system's resolver configuration, or map the name with the `resolve` setting.
error_codes.name: name_lookup_failed

error_codes.description: The resolver found no address for the host name. The engine's own resolver, used on Linux and for Sessions with a local address, reads the system's resolver configuration and hosts file but asks neither NSS modules (such as a directory service or a VPN client's) nor multicast DNS, so a name only they resolve, such as a `.local` name, fails here. Map such a name to its address with the `resolve` setting, or correct the name.
error_codes.name: name_not_resolved

error_codes.description: The running engine's Product does not carry what was asked: a Client that needs Foxhound reached a Collie engine, or a call, a setting or a value only Foxhound carries reached one. Run it with Foxhound, which contains everything Collie does, or connect to a Foxhound engine.
error_codes.name: not_in_product

error_codes.description: The engine does not speak the protocol version the Client's `hello` names: it accepts its own major with the same or an older minor. Upgrade the older side.
error_codes.name: protocol_version_unsupported

error_codes.description: The sample crawl refused its pages.
error_codes.name: sample_crawl_refused

error_codes.description: The sample operation refused the text.
error_codes.name: sample_refused

error_groups.description: The program is wrong: its call, its settings or its own handler code. Fix the program.

error_groups.description: A policy, a Limit, a lock or a person refused. Change a setting, raise the Limit or ask the operator.
error_groups.name: refused

error_groups.description: The page or site never reached the state the call needed. Read the Run trace; change the step, the wait or the Access mode.
error_groups.name: page

error_groups.description: The Model provider's answer was unusable. Change the model or the strategy.
error_groups.name: model

error_groups.description: The deadline passed. Raise it, or wait for the right thing.
error_groups.name: deadline_exceeded

error_groups.description: Something Goodfetch depends on is unreachable or gone. Retry, or fix the setup.
error_groups.name: unavailable

error_groups.description: A bug in Goodfetch. Report it.
error_groups.name: internal
